title: Execute Raw SQL Queries
description: Learn to execute raw SQL queries using FromSql method.

data.text: Use `DbSet.FromSql()` to execute raw SQL queries and get results as entity objects.

data.title: FromSql Example
Parameterized Query
LINQ with FromSql
data.code:
var students = context.Students
    .FromSql("SELECT * FROM Students WHERE Name = '{0}'", name)
    .OrderBy(s => s.StudentId)
    .ToList();

items: Must return entities of the same type as DbSet<T>
Must return all columns of the table
Cannot include JOIN queries for related data

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Has limitations on result type and columns
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about ExecuteDelete for bulk operations.
